cases.title: Scenario matrix row for logout clears session and protects routes
preconditions: Testing-plan §12 Authentication lifecycle row applies (FR-38; BR-24; AC-26).
Role-matrix fixture provides at least Student and Lecturer authenticated sessions.
steps: Establish authenticated session for each role.
Attempt protected API read for each role without re-login.
Attempt protected frontend route deep link without re-login.
cases.expected: Given/When/Then per AC-26: credentials cleared, login redirect on protected routes, API returns 401 Unauthenticated until re-authentication.

cases.title: HTTP contract logout then GET /v1/me and protected resource denial
preconditions: AcademicAdmin account exists; client holds valid accessToken.
steps: POST /v1/auth/logout with bearer token; assert HTTP 200 loggedOut.
GET /v1/me without Authorization; assert HTTP 401 Unauthenticated.
GET /v1/policies without Authorization; assert HTTP 401 Unauthenticated.
cases.expected: AC-26 satisfied at API boundary: logout clears effective session for client; protected reads require new authentication.

cases.title: FLOW-15 voluntary logout without returnUrl then FLOW-14 re-login
preconditions: Student authenticated via PG-01 with prior returnUrl to check-in is not used for voluntary logout path.
steps: From authenticated student shell, invoke logout (FLOW-15).
Confirm landing on PG-01 with no returnUrl parameter.
Confirm protected student route is accessible after re-login.
cases.expected: Voluntary logout does not preserve returnUrl; re-login restores authenticated access per AC-26 and FR-38.
